note: Smittybilt SRC at $449; buy frame-tied sliders if you will ever jack or winch off them.
Teraflex 2.5-inch kit, the guide's proven start; it clears 35s while the factory control arm geometry still works.
TeraFlex adjustable bar; the lift is not finished until the axle is re-centered and aligned.
Five 35x12.50R17 all-terrains at about $420 each on stock or take-off wheels; on 3.73 gears 35s run sluggish, while a Rubicon's 4.10s handle them.
Synergy chromoly tie rod; the stock tube bends on a hard rock hit, so inspect the drag link too.
Rated shackles and D-ring mounts; the factory tow hooks are not rated for recovery, and a kinetic rope is the next piece.
Teraflex kit for engine, transfer case and fuel tank; skids are year-specific, so match 2007-2011 or 2012-2018.
Eaton ELocker, electric with no compressor. Skip on a Rubicon, which has a factory rear locker.
4.56 on both axles for 35s, about the middle of the guide's $1,200 to $2,400 installed. A Rubicon's 4.10s can wait; go straight to 4.88 if 37s are coming.
Iron Rock at $699 has a winch plate rated for 12,000 pounds, which a 10,000-pound winch needs. Plan on heavier front springs for the added weight.
Warn VR EVO 10-S, the 10,000-pound class this guide sets for a JK.
Smittybilt XRC Gen3 carries a 35-inch spare; the factory carrier is built for 31 to 33 inches.
Rock Krawler 3.5-inch RRD, bolt-on and the minimum lift for 37s. A JK needs no SYE; a longer rear driveshaft is the fix.
Five Pro Comp 17x9 steel wheels at $89 each; confirm 4.5 to 4.75 inches of backspacing before mounting 37s.
Redo at 4.88, the ratio the 37s guide calls required; this replaces the 4.56 set.
Five 37x12.5R17s; a Rubicon fits them at 3.5 inches with less trimming, and other trims need fender work.
Artec C-gussets at about $93 and MetalCloak chromoly shafts at $579; the gussets need a welder. A Rubicon has a Dana 44 front.
ARB for the Dana 30, only after the rear is locked; the Dana 30 is a weak point under 37s. Skip on a Rubicon, which has a factory front locker.
Mishimoto aluminum radiator ends the end-tank cracking failure; the OEM Mopar at $285 is the stock fix.
